events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 cut 블랙번 로버스's Premier League lead to five points with a 3–2 away win over relegation threatened 코번트리 시티, with Andy Cole scoring twice – taking his tally for United to 11 goals in 15 league games. 알렉스 퍼거슨, whose team have a game in hand, speaks of his belief that the title race could still go the last game of the season.
사우샘프턴's safety is confirmed with a 3–1 home win over 크리스털 팰리스, who remain in the bottom four.

노리치 시티's relegation is confirmed as they lose 2–1 at 리즈 유나이티드, a mere four months after they had been in contention for a UEFA Cup place and two seasons after they had almost won the inaugural Premier League title. 에버턴 move closer to safety with a goalless draw at home to 사우샘프턴. 애스턴 빌라 are also still in danger of going down despite a 2–0 home win over 리버풀.
맨체스터 유나이티드 continue to put the pressure on 블랙번 로버스 as a David May goal gives them a 1–0 home win over 셰필드 웬즈데이 and cuts the gap to two points.

블랙번 로버스 maintain their lead at the top of the Premier League when Alan Shearer scores the only goal of a 1–0 win against his hometown club 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, meaning that they will be champions in two days time if 맨체스터 유나이티드 fail to beat 사우샘프턴.

맨체스터 유나이티드 ensure the title race goes to the final game of the season after beating 사우샘프턴 2–1 at Old Trafford. Simon Charlton had given the visitors an early lead before Andy Cole equalised to score his 12th goal in 17 league games, with 데니스 어윈 converting a penalty to secure victory for United just minutes before the championship celebrations were set to begin in 블랙번 로버스 . 웨스트햄 유나이티드 secure their survival with a 3–0 win over 리버풀, who as League Cup winners will still qualify for the UEFA Cup even if they fail to finish in the top five. 애스턴 빌라 and 셰필드 웬즈데이 are now the only teams that 크리스털 팰리스 might be overhaul on the final day of the season in the battle to avoid the final relegation place.

윔블던 and 노팅엄 포리스트 complete their Premier League campaigns with a 2–2 draw at Selhurst Park . Forest have secured a third-place finish and a UEFA Cup campaign – their first European campaign in 11 years – on their Premier League comeback, while 윔블던 have comfortably secured a tenth successive season in the top flight and a second successive top 10 finish.

블랙번 로버스 are crowned league champions for the first time in 81 years, despite losing 2–1 at 리버풀 on the final day of the season. 블랙번 로버스's title status was confirmed after 맨체스터 유나이티드 could only manage a 1–1 draw with a spirited 웨스트햄 유나이티드. The final Premier League relegation place goes to 크리스털 팰리스, despite their dynamic fightback from being 3–0 down at 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 they still lose 3–2, while 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are beaten to a UEFA Cup place, with Leeds securing the final place in the competition. 애스턴 빌라's safety is confirmed by a 1–1 draw with already-relegated 노리치 시티 at Carrow Road . 셰필드 웬즈데이's safety is confirmed by a 4–1 win at home to doomed 입스위치 타운.
Alan Smith is sacked as manager of relegated 크리스털 팰리스.
Trevor Francis is sacked after four years as manager of 셰필드 웬즈데이.
에버턴 claims the English FA Cup with a 1–0 win over 맨체스터 유나이티드 .

에버턴 win the FA Cup thanks to a Paul Rideout goal in the final, which leaves 맨체스터 유나이티드 (who narrowly missed out on repeating the double) without a major trophy for the first time since 1989. Rideout's goal came in the 30th minute, and United made a few late attempts to equalise (including two extremely close attempts by 폴 스콜스 in the dying minutes of the game) but all shots were foiled by a courageous Neville Southall .

폴 인스 is cleared of assaulting a 크리스털 팰리스 supporter in the skirmish that followed 에리크 캉토나's attack on Matthew Simmons four months ago. It was already known that the spectator who accused Ince of assault had a history of football-related violence dating back to the early 1970s.
UEFA Champions League won by 아약스 after defeating A.C. AC 밀란 in the 에른스트 하펠 Stadium through a goal from Patrick Kluivert .
체스터필드 end their six-year spell in the fourth tier of the Football League with a 2–0 win over Bury in the Division Three playoff final.
허더즈필드 타운 win the Division Two playoff final by beating 브리스틀 로버스 2–1.
The Division One playoff final sees Bolton end their 15-year absence from the top flight with a 4–3 win over Reading. Bolton had trailed 2–0 until the 75th minute and the match went into extra time.
맨체스터 시티, still looking for a new manager following the dismissal of Brian Horton , agree to sell striker 나이얼 퀸 to 스포르팅 of Portugal in a £2million deal.
Dutch superstar 뤼트 휠릿 accepts an offer to join 첼시 on a free transfer from 삼프도리아 .
